tip_zh: point 作动词是“指”：point at / point to。There is no point in doing 表示做某事没有意义。

definition_en: a business, or the state of being with someone
example1_en: Her mother works for a bus company.
example1_zh: 她母亲在一家公交公司工作。
example2_en: A company that moves its factory should also say what will happen to the workers who stay behind.
example2_zh: 搬迁工厂的公司，也应该说明留下来的工人会怎样。
collocations: keep sb company｜陪伴某人 ; company policy｜公司政策
tip_zh: company 表示陪伴时不可数：for company。表示公司时可数。

definition_en: not one, or not any
example1_en: None of the answers is correct.
example1_zh: 这些答案没有一个是对的。
example2_en: None of the night buses reach the village, so the clinic might as well be closed after dark.
example2_zh: 夜班公交没有一趟到村子，所以诊所天黑后等于关了。
collocations: none of｜……中没有一个
tip_zh: none of 加复数时谓语可用单数或复数；强调“一个也没有”时常用单数。

definition_en: to appear to be
example1_en: The question seems easy at first.
example1_zh: 这道题起初似乎很容易。
example2_en: A street can seem safe in daylight and still be dark for the walk home at night.
example2_zh: 一条街在白天可以看起来安全，夜里回家时仍然很黑。
collocations: seem to do｜似乎做 ; it seems that｜似乎
tip_zh: seem 后接形容词、to do 或 that 从句。

definition_en: in spite of that, or in any case
example1_en: It was raining, but we walked anyway.
example1_zh: 当时在下雨，但我们还是走了。
example2_en: The poster looks fine. Anyway, the real question is whether the bus arrives.
example2_zh: 海报看起来不错。无论如何，真正的问题是公交是否到达。
collocations: anyway｜反正
tip_zh: anyway 多用于口语，常放在句首或句末。

meanings_zh: n. 解释 | n. 原因；解释理由
definition_en: words that make something clear | a reason given for why something happened
example1_en: Her explanation helped us understand.
example1_zh: 她的解释帮助我们理解。
example2_en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。
collocations: clear explanation｜清楚的解释 ; give an explanation｜作出解释 ; explanation for｜对……的原因解释 ; explanation of｜对……的说明
tip_zh: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

definition_en: whole
example1_en: The entire class passed the test.
example1_zh: 整个班级都通过了考试。

definition_en: almost
example1_en: It is nearly eight.
example1_zh: 快八点了。
example2_en: A clinic that is nearly an hour away is too far for a child who cannot breathe well.
example2_zh: 将近一小时路程的诊所，对呼吸困难的孩子来说太远了。
collocations: nearly all｜几乎全部
tip_zh: nearly 和 almost 常可互换；almost 更能修饰 no 和 never。

meanings_zh: v. 跳舞 | n. 舞蹈；舞会
definition_en: to move to music | a set of movements, or a social event
example1_en: They dance in the hall on Fridays.
example1_zh: 他们周五在大厅跳舞。
example2_en: A school dance can bring a class together if the cost does not keep some students out.
example2_zh: 如果费用不把一些学生挡在外面，学校舞会可以把一个班聚在一起。
collocations: dance to｜随着……跳舞
tip_zh: dance 也可作名词“舞蹈”。

definition_en: liked more than others
example1_en: Blue is her favorite colour.
example1_zh: 蓝色是她最喜欢的颜色。
example2_en: A student's favorite reading place may be a shared table, not a quiet room of their own.
example2_zh: 学生最喜欢的阅读地点可能是一张共用的桌子，而不是自己的安静房间。
collocations: favorite book｜最喜欢的书
tip_zh: favorite 是美式拼写；英式是 favourite。意思相同。

definition_en: further than, or outside the range of
example1_en: The village is beyond the hill.
example1_zh: 村子在山的那一边。
example2_en: The cost of dirty air goes beyond the hospital bill and into lost days at school.
example2_zh: 脏空气的代价超出医院账单，还包括在学校损失的天数。
collocations: beyond doubt｜毫无疑问
tip_zh: beyond 是介词，后接名词。

meanings_zh: v. 改变；更换 | n. 变化；零钱
definition_en: to become different, or to replace | a difference, or coins returned
example1_en: We changed the time of the meeting.
example1_zh: 我们改了开会时间。
example2_en: Cities that change bus routes without warning leave workers late and children waiting in the dark.
example2_zh: 不预先通知就更改公交线路的城市，会让工人迟到，让孩子在黑暗中等候。
collocations: change into｜变成 ; change one's mind｜改变主意
tip_zh: change 可作及物或不及物动词。

meanings_zh: v. 竞争 | v. 参加比赛
definition_en: to try to win against others | Take part in a sporting event or other contest.
example1_en: Many teams compete for the prize.
example1_zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。
example2_en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
example2_zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。
collocations: compete with｜与……竞争 ; compete for｜争夺 ; compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip_zh: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

definition_en: a period of one hundred years
example1_en: The bridge was built in the last century.
example1_zh: 这座桥建于上个世纪。
example2_en: A town that grew in one century can lose its river in a single decade of careless building.
example2_zh: 一个世纪里成长起来的城镇，可能在十年粗心的建设中失去它的河。
collocations: the 21st century｜21世纪
tip_zh: in the twentieth century 表示在二十世纪。

definition_en: prepared
example1_en: Are you ready for the listening test?
example1_zh: 听力测试你准备好了吗？
example2_en: A town is not ready for a flood if the only high road is already full of parked cars.
example2_zh: 如果唯一的高路已经停满车，一个城镇就还没有为洪水做好准备。
collocations: be ready to do｜准备好做 ; get ready｜做准备
tip_zh: be ready for 后接名词；be ready to do 后接动词。

meanings_zh: n. 得分；分数 | v. 得分
definition_en: the points in a game or test | to get a point or a mark
example1_en: The final score was two to one.
example1_zh: 最终比分是二比一。
example2_en: A low score on a listening test may show noise in the room, not only a weak ear.
example2_zh: 听力测验分数低，可能说明房间吵，而不只是耳朵不行。
collocations: score a goal｜进球 ; full score｜满分
tip_zh: score 作动词是得分。比分的说法是 two to one。

meanings_zh: adj. 独立的 | adj. 不受控制的；独立的 | adj. 无关联的；互不影响的
definition_en: not needing others' control | not controlled by another person, organisation, or country | not connected with or affected by something else
example1_en: She became more independent at college.
example1_zh: 她上大学后更独立了。
example2_en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
example2_zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。
collocations: financially independent｜经济独立的 ; independent research｜独立研究 ; independent of｜不依赖；不受影响 ; independent judgement｜独立判断
tip_zh: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

definition_en: on
example1_en: The decision depends upon the bus timetable.
example1_zh: 这个决定取决于公交时刻表。
example2_en: Once upon a time is a story opening, but real towns still depend upon roads and water.
example2_zh: Once upon a time 是故事的开头，但真实的城镇仍然依靠道路和水。
collocations: once upon a time｜从前 ; depend upon｜依靠
tip_zh: upon 比 on 更正式，意思常常相同。

definition_en: to stay, or to be left
example1_en: Please remain in your seats until the bell.
example1_zh: 铃响前请留在座位上。
example2_en: The questions that remain after a lesson are often the ones worth writing down.
example2_zh: 一节课结束后仍留下的问题，往往值得写下来。
collocations: remain silent｜保持沉默 ; it remains to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip_zh: remain 是连系动词，后接形容词：remain calm。不能说 remain to do 表示“仍然要做”时要小心，剩下要做的常用 it remains to do。

definition_en: a thought or plan
example1_en: That is a good idea for the poster.
example1_zh: 对海报来说那是个好主意。
example2_en: An idea for a new park fails if nobody asks who will water the trees after the opening day.
example2_zh: 如果没人问开放日之后谁来给树浇水，建新公园的想法就会失败。
collocations: have no idea｜不知道 ; the idea of｜……的想法
tip_zh: idea 是可数名词：an idea。

definition_en: one side of a sheet in a book
example1_en: The answer is on page twelve.
example1_zh: 答案在第十二页。
example2_en: A torn page in a shared textbook matters when the school cannot buy a new copy.
example2_zh: 当学校买不起新书时，共用课本上撕掉的一页就很要紧。
collocations: on page｜在第……页 ; front page｜头版
tip_zh: page 前用 on：on page 5。

definition_en: to make a picture, or to pull
example1_en: Draw the map before you write the paragraph.
example1_zh: 写段落之前先把地图画出来。
example2_en: Cities draw young workers when housing and night buses exist, not only when the posters are bright.
example2_zh: 当住房和夜班公交都存在时，城市才会吸引年轻工人，而不只是海报鲜亮的时候。
collocations: draw a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw up｜起草
tip_zh: draw 的过去式是 drew，过去分词是 drawn。draw 也可表示吸引。

meanings_zh: v. 行动；表演 | n. 行为；法令
definition_en: to do something, or to perform | something done, or a law
example1_en: We must act before the river rises again.
example1_zh: 我们必须在河水再次上涨前行动。
example2_en: Schools that act on student suggestions show that those suggestions were not only a form to fill.
example2_zh: 根据学生建议采取行动的学校，表明那些建议不只是一张要填的表。
collocations: act as｜充当 ; act on｜按照……行动
tip_zh: act 强调行动；action 是名词。

definition_en: one of the four parts of the year, or a sports period
example1_en: Autumn is my favourite season.
example1_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
example2_en: A long dry season can empty village wells before the next rain arrives.
example2_zh: 漫长的旱季会在下一场雨到来前抽干村里的水井。
collocations: rainy season｜雨季 ; in season｜当令
tip_zh: 季节前常用 in：in summer。

definition_en: towards a lower place
example1_en: Please sit down and open your books.
example1_zh: 请坐下，把书打开。
example2_en: When a factory closes down, the town has to find new work for the people who stayed.
example2_zh: 当一家工厂倒闭时，城镇必须为留下来的人找到新的工作。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; write down｜写下 ; up and down｜上上下下
tip_zh: down 可作副词或介词：walk down the street。

meanings_zh: v. 猜测 | n. 猜测
definition_en: to give an answer without being sure | an answer given without proof
example1_en: Can you guess the last word?
example1_zh: 你能猜出最后一个词吗？
example2_en: Planners should not guess where floods reach when residents can show them the marks on the wall.
example2_zh: 当居民能指出墙上的水痕时，规划者不该猜测洪水淹到哪里。
collocations: guess at｜猜测 ; I guess｜我想
tip_zh: guess 后可直接接从句。

definition_en: a piece of equipment that does work
example1_en: This machine copies the notice for every class.
example1_zh: 这台机器给每个班复印通知。
example2_en: A washing machine saves time, but a school still has to teach students how to share one.
example2_zh: 洗衣机能省时间，但学校仍要教学生如何共用一台。
collocations: washing machine｜洗衣机
tip_zh: machine 是可数名词。统称机器设备常用 machinery，不可数。

definition_en: having the power or skill to do something
example1_en: She is able to explain the diagram clearly.
example1_zh: 她能把这张图讲清楚。
example2_en: Students are more able to concentrate when the classroom is quiet and the air is fresh.
example2_zh: 当教室安静、空气新鲜时，学生更能集中注意力。
collocations: be able to｜能够 ; able student｜有能力的学生
tip_zh: can 多指一般能力；be able to 可用于各种时态，并强调做成。

meanings_zh: n. 焦点；重点 | n. 重点；关注中心 | n. 清晰度；焦点
definition_en: the center of attention | the main subject receiving attention or effort | image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet
example1_en: Keep your focus on the task.
example1_zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。
example2_en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。
collocations: focus on｜集中于 ; the main focus｜主要关注点 ; in focus｜影像清晰 ; out of focus｜影像模糊
tip_zh: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

meanings_zh: adj. 红色的 | n. 红色
definition_en: of the colour of blood | the colour red
example1_en: The red bag on the chair is mine.
example1_zh: 椅子上的红包是我的。
example2_en: Red warnings on a river app help only if people who live nearby can actually receive them.
example2_zh: 河流应用上的红色警报只有在附近居民真能收到时才有用。
collocations: red light｜红灯
tip_zh: red 也可作名词表示红色。

definition_en: the main meal of the day
example1_en: Dinner is at six in our hall.
example1_zh: 我们食堂六点开晚饭。
example2_en: A free dinner at school can matter more than a speech about healthy food.
example2_zh: 学校的一顿免费晚餐，可能比一场关于健康饮食的演讲更重要。
collocations: have dinner｜吃晚饭 ; dinner party｜宴会
tip_zh: dinner 在不同地方可以指午餐或晚餐，都是一天的正餐。

definition_en: to carry something towards the speaker
example1_en: Please bring your student card tomorrow.
example1_zh: 请明天带学生证。
example2_en: New jobs bring people to a town only if there is also a place for them to live.
example2_zh: 只有同时有地方住，新工作才会把人带到一个城镇。
collocations: bring about｜引起 ; bring up｜抚养；提出
tip_zh: bring 是带来（朝说话人）；take 是带走。过去式是 brought。

definition_en: of several different kinds
example1_en: The library has various maps of the town.
example1_zh: 图书馆有各种各样的城镇地图。
example2_en: Various reasons, from rent to bus times, push young workers out of a small town.
example2_zh: 从房租到公交时间，各种各样的原因把年轻工人推出小镇。
collocations: various kinds of｜各种各样的
tip_zh: various 后接复数名词。

definition_en: why something happens
example1_en: The reason for the delay was the rain.
example1_zh: 延误的原因是下雨。
example2_en: The reason a street floods is often an old drain, not only a heavy cloud.
example2_zh: 街道积水的原因常常是旧排水管，而不只是厚云。
collocations: the reason for｜……的原因 ; the reason why｜……的原因
tip_zh: the reason 后用 why 或 that，不要再用 because 重复原因。

definition_en: the organ of sight
example1_en: She has brown eyes.
example1_zh: 她有棕色的眼睛。
example2_en: Too little light in a classroom tires the eye before the lesson is over.
example2_zh: 教室光线太暗，课还没结束眼睛就累了。
collocations: keep an eye on｜照看 ; in the eyes of｜在……看来
tip_zh: eye 的复数是 eyes。

meanings_zh: adj. 频繁的 | v. 常去；常到访
definition_en: happening often | Visit a particular place regularly
example1_en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
example1_zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。
example2_en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
example2_zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。
collocations: frequent visits｜频繁到访 ; frequent delays｜频繁延误 ; a frequent visitor｜常客 ; frequent changes｜频繁变化
tip_zh: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

definition_en: happening a short time ago
example1_en: A recent photo shows the new bridge.
example1_zh: 一张近照展示了新桥。
example2_en: Recent floods should change where the town allows new houses, not only this year's repairs.
example2_zh: 最近的洪水应该改变城镇允许建新房的位置，而不只是今年的修补。
collocations: in recent years｜近年来
tip_zh: recent 是形容词；recently 是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 结尾；末端 | v. 结束
definition_en: the last part of something | to finish
example1_en: Please write your name at the end of the page.
example1_zh: 请把名字写在页尾。
example2_en: The end of a holiday is a good time to ask which local shops actually benefited from the visitors.
example2_zh: 假期结束时，适合问问哪些本地店铺真正从游客那里获益。
collocations: in the end｜最后 ; at the end of｜在……末尾 ; end up｜最终成为
tip_zh: in the end 表示最终；at the end of 后面要接具体的时间或事物。

definition_en: a contract that pays if something bad happens
example1_en: Health insurance helped the family pay the bill.
example1_zh: 健康保险帮助这个家庭付了账单。
example2_en: Insurance does not replace a clinic that is close enough to reach at night.
example2_zh: 保险替代不了一家夜里能够到达的诊所。
collocations: health insurance｜健康保险
tip_zh: insurance 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 希望；祝愿 | n. 愿望
definition_en: to want something that may not be real | a desire
example1_en: I wish you a good journey.
example1_zh: 祝你旅途愉快。
example2_en: Residents wish the clinic were closer, but wishes do not move a building.
example2_zh: 居民希望诊所更近，但愿望搬不走一座楼。
collocations: wish to do｜希望做 ; wish sb sth｜祝愿某人
tip_zh: wish 后接虚拟语气，表示与事实相反；hope 后接真实的希望。

definition_en: a flower with a sweet smell and thorns
example1_en: She put a rose on the teacher's desk.
example1_zh: 她在老师桌上放了一朵玫瑰。
example2_en: A rose in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
example2_zh: 学校花园里的玫瑰在八月需要浇水，而那时大多数学生不在。
collocations: a red rose｜红玫瑰
tip_zh: rose 也是 rise（上升）的过去式。作花名时是名词。

definition_en: to begin to be
example1_en: The room will become quiet when the talk starts.
example1_zh: 讲座开始时房间会安静下来。
example2_en: A neighbourhood can become unsafe for walking if shops close and the street lights fail.
example2_zh: 如果商店关门、路灯不亮，一个社区会变得不适合步行。
collocations: become of｜发生……情况
tip_zh: become 后接形容词或名词，不加 to be。过去分词仍是 become。

definition_en: land with water all around it
example1_en: We read a story about a small island.
example1_zh: 我们读了一个关于小岛的故事。
example2_en: An island school depends on the boat timetable as much as on its teachers.
example2_zh: 岛上的学校对船的时刻表的依赖，不亚于对老师的依赖。
collocations: on an island｜在岛上
tip_zh: island 前的元音用 an：an island。

definition_en: chance, especially good chance
example1_en: Good luck on the oral test tomorrow.
example1_zh: 祝你明天口语考试好运。
example2_en: Luck may open a door, but a student still has to walk through it with preparation.
example2_zh: 运气也许能打开一扇门，但学生仍要靠准备自己走进去。
collocations: good luck｜好运 ; a stroke of luck｜一次走运
tip_zh: luck 不可数。祝愿用 Good luck，不要说 a good luck。

definition_en: the earth, or a particular area of activity
example1_en: Students from three countries joined the world map project.
example1_zh: 来自三个国家的学生参加了世界地图项目。
example2_en: The online world gives teenagers a voice, but it also spreads rumours faster than a classroom can correct them.
example2_zh: 网络世界给了青少年发言的机会，但谣言传播的速度也快过课堂能够纠正的速度。
collocations: all over the world｜全世界 ; in the world｜在世界上
tip_zh: in the world 常与最高级连用，加强语气。

definition_en: to take liquid into the mouth | a liquid for drinking
example1_en: Drink some water before the run.
example1_zh: 跑步前喝点水。
example2_en: Towns that drink from the same river have to agree on what factories may pour into it.
example2_zh: 共用一条河取水的城镇，必须约定工厂可以向河里排什么。
collocations: drink water｜喝水 ; soft drink｜软饮料
tip_zh: drink 的过去式是 drank，过去分词是 drunk。

definition_en: a group with a purpose, or the act of arranging
example1_en: The organization collected books for the village school.
example1_zh: 这个组织为乡村学校收集了书。
example2_en: Good organization of a fire drill matters more than a long speech about safety.
example2_zh: 消防演习的良好组织，比关于安全的长篇讲话更重要。
collocations: international organization｜国际组织
tip_zh: organization 是美式拼写；英式常用 organisation。

definition_en: to gain knowledge or skill
example1_en: We learn new words by using them.
example1_zh: 我们通过使用来学会生词。
example2_en: Children learn road safety by walking with an adult, not only by reading a poster.
example2_zh: 孩子通过和成年人一起走路来学习交通安全，而不只是读海报。
collocations: learn to do｜学做 ; learn from｜向……学习
tip_zh: learn 强调学会；study 强调学习的过程。

definition_en: protection, or the argument for someone
example1_en: The town's defense against floods is still a low wall.
example1_zh: 城镇的防洪仍然只是一堵矮墙。
example2_en: A strong defense of a plan should include the people who disagree with it.
example2_zh: 对一个计划的有力辩护，应该包括不同意它的人。
collocations: in defense of｜为……辩护
tip_zh: defense 是美式拼写；英式是 defence。

meanings_zh: n. 南；南方 | adj. 南方的
definition_en: the direction opposite north | in or towards the south
example1_en: The library is to the south of the stadium.
example1_zh: 图书馆在体育馆南边。
example2_en: Towns in the south may face longer summers, which changes when schools can hold sports outdoors.
example2_zh: 南方的城镇可能面临更长的夏天，这会改变学校何时能在户外运动。
collocations: in the south｜在南方 ; South Africa｜南非
tip_zh: in the south of 表示在某范围的南部；to the south of 表示在某地以南。

definition_en: of great weight, or severe
example1_en: The box is too heavy for one person.
example1_zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重。
example2_en: Heavy rain on a street with small drains becomes a flood within an hour.
example2_zh: 排水管很小的街道上的大雨，会在一小时内变成洪水。
collocations: heavy rain｜大雨 ; heavy traffic｜交通拥堵
tip_zh: heavy 的比较级是 heavier。

definition_en: fairly, or preferably
example1_en: The question is rather difficult.
example1_zh: 这道题相当难。
example2_en: Many students would rather walk than take a bus that arrives after the gate has closed.
example2_zh: 许多学生宁愿走路，也不愿坐一辆校门关上后才到的公交。
collocations: rather than｜而不是 ; would rather｜宁愿
tip_zh: would rather do than do 表示宁愿……而不愿。rather than 后常接不带 to 的动词。

definition_en: to cause pain, or to feel pain
example1_en: My knee hurts after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛后我的膝盖疼。
example2_en: Words can hurt, and a false story about a classmate can last longer than the speaker expects.
example2_zh: 话能伤人，关于同学的假故事可能比说话的人预计的更长久。
collocations: hurt oneself｜伤到自己 ; get hurt｜受伤
tip_zh: hurt 的过去式和过去分词仍是 hurt。

definition_en: belonging to me | a place where minerals are dug
example1_en: This bag is mine.
example1_zh: 这个包是我的。
example2_en: A river is not mine or yours alone; the town downstream drinks from it too.
example2_zh: 一条河不是我的或你一个人的；下游的城镇也从中取水。
collocations: a friend of mine｜我的一个朋友
tip_zh: 名词性物主代词 mine 后面不再加名词。mine 作名词是“矿”。

definition_en: if not, or in a different way
example1_en: Hurry up; otherwise we will miss the bus.
example1_zh: 快点，否则我们会错过公交。
example2_en: Write the source down; otherwise a later reader cannot tell a fact from a guess.
example2_zh: 把来源写下来，否则后来的读者分不清事实和猜测。
collocations: or otherwise｜或相反
tip_zh: otherwise 可单独作“否则”。和 or 连用时不要再堆一个 else。

definition_en: a tall plant with a trunk and branches
example1_en: The old tree by the gate gives shade.
example1_zh: 门口的老树提供树荫。
example2_en: One tree in a schoolyard does not cool a city, but a row of them can change a street.
example2_zh: 校园里的一棵树凉不了一座城，但一排树可以改变一条街。
collocations: family tree｜家谱 ; climb a tree｜爬树
tip_zh: tree 可数。木头作为材料用 wood，不是 tree。

definition_en: to make something by putting parts together
example1_en: They plan to build a bridge over the river.
example1_zh: 他们计划在河上建一座桥。
example2_en: Towns that build only roads forget that children also need a pavement.
example2_zh: 只修路的城镇忘了孩子也需要人行道。
collocations: build up｜增强 ; build on｜在……上建造
tip_zh: build 的过去式和过去分词是 built。

definition_en: knowing about something
example1_en: Be aware of the risks.
example1_zh: 要意识到风险。

definition_en: happening once a year
example1_en: The annual sports meet is in May.
example1_zh: 一年一度的运动会在五月。
example2_en: An annual check of the school roof costs less than the damage after one storm.
example2_zh: 每年检查一次校舍屋顶，比一场暴风雨之后的损坏更省。
collocations: annual meeting｜年会
tip_zh: annual 是形容词；annually 是副词。

meanings_zh: v. 结合；联合 | n. 联合收割机
definition_en: to join together | A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.
example1_en: Good teachers combine hard work with creativity.
example1_zh: 好老师把努力与创造力结合起来。
example2_en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市可以将公共交通改善与更安全的骑行路线建设相结合，减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: combine A with B｜把A与B结合 ; combine efforts｜合力 ; combine theory and practice｜理论与实践相结合
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；收割机名词读/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

definition_en: an adult male, or humans in general
example1_en: A man from the bookshop helped us find the map.
example1_zh: 书店里的一位男士帮我们找到了那张地图。
example2_en: For most of history, man changed the land slowly; the last century has been different.
example2_zh: 在历史上的大部分时间里，人类改变土地的速度很慢；上一个世纪则不同。
collocations: man-made｜人造的
tip_zh: man 泛指人类时较少用于新的正式写作，更常见的是 humans 或 people。

definition_en: the reflexive form of it
example1_en: The door closed by itself.
example1_zh: 门自己关上了。
example2_en: A warning system that fails itself is worse than no system, because people trust it.
example2_zh: 自己失灵的警报系统比没有系统更糟，因为人们信任它。
collocations: by itself｜独自；自动
tip_zh: itself 指事物或动物，不指人。

definition_en: before the usual time | before the expected time
example1_en: I caught the early bus.
example1_zh: 我赶上了早班车。
example2_en: Early support in reading costs less than trying to repair years of failure later.
example2_zh: 早期的阅读帮助，比日后修补多年的失败更省。
collocations: early morning｜清晨 ; as early as｜早在
tip_zh: early 既可作形容词也可作副词：arrive early。

definition_en: the ability to remember, or something remembered
example1_en: The song brings back a memory of primary school.
example1_zh: 这首歌唤起一段小学的回忆。
example2_en: Public memory of a flood fades unless the photos stay in the library.
example2_zh: 除非照片留在图书馆，否则公众对一场洪水的记忆会消退。
collocations: in memory of｜为纪念 ; a good memory｜好记性
tip_zh: memory 表示记性时多不可数；表示一段回忆时可数。电脑内存也叫 memory。

definition_en: a computer set of instructions, a show, or a plan
example1_en: The program helps students check new words.
example1_zh: 这个程序帮助学生检查生词。
example2_en: A training program for village teachers fails if it requires them to leave their classes for a month.
example2_zh: 如果乡村教师培训计划要求他们离开课堂一个月，这个计划就会失败。
collocations: computer program｜计算机程序 ; TV program｜电视节目
tip_zh: 英式拼写 programme 常指节目或计划；计算机程序英美都常用 program。

meanings_zh: n. 预算 | v. 编制预算
definition_en: a plan of how money will be spent | to plan how to spend money
example1_en: The club budget cannot pay for two trips.
example1_zh: 社团预算付不起两次出行。
example2_en: A school budget that forgets heating discovers the mistake in the first cold week.
example2_zh: 忘了供暖的学校预算，会在第一个寒冷的星期发现错误。
collocations: on a budget｜预算有限 ; family budget｜家庭预算
tip_zh: budget 作动词是编制预算。

definition_en: for each
example1_en: The room costs twenty yuan per hour.
example1_zh: 这间房间每小时二十元。
example2_en: Cities that measure water use per person can see which habits waste the most.
example2_zh: 按每人用水量统计的城市，能看出哪些习惯最浪费。
collocations: per cent｜百分之 ; per person｜每人
tip_zh: per 多用于书面；口语里常用 a 或 every，如 twenty yuan an hour。

definition_en: more than usual, or in particular
example1_en: The library is busy, especially before exams.
example1_zh: 图书馆很忙，尤其是考试前。
example2_en: Night buses matter especially for workers who finish after the regular service has stopped.
example2_zh: 夜班公交对那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人尤其重要。
collocations: especially important｜尤其重要
tip_zh: especially 强调“尤其”；specially 强调“专门地”。

definition_en: a fully grown person
example1_en: An adult must sign the trip form.
example1_zh: 出行表必须由成年人签字。
example2_en: Evening classes give adults a second chance without asking them to leave work.
example2_zh: 夜校给成年人第二次机会，又不必让他们辞去工作。
collocations: adult education｜成人教育
tip_zh: adult 也可作形容词“成年的”。

definition_en: a hole, a start, or a job that is free
example1_en: The opening of the clinic is next month.
example1_zh: 诊所下月开业。
example2_en: An opening for a village teacher stays empty if the housing is an hour from the school.
example2_zh: 如果住房离学校一小时，乡村教师的空缺就会一直空着。
collocations: job opening｜职位空缺 ; opening hours｜营业时间
tip_zh: opening 是可数名词。

definition_en: the condition of the body or mind
example1_en: Sleep is part of health, not a reward after study.
example1_zh: 睡眠是健康的一部分，不是学完之后的奖赏。
example2_en: Poor air quality is a public health problem, not only a matter of personal choice.
example2_zh: 糟糕的空气质量是公共健康问题，不只是个人选择。
collocations: in good health｜身体健康 ; mental health｜心理健康
tip_zh: health 不可数。healthy 是形容词。

definition_en: able to be moved
example1_en: The clinic uses a mobile screen in the hallway.
example1_zh: 诊所在走廊里用一块可移动的屏。
example2_en: A mobile phone in class is useful for a timetable and harmful when it replaces the lesson.
example2_zh: 课堂上的手机对查看课表有用，如果它取代了课本身就有害。
collocations: mobile phone｜手机
tip_zh: mobile phone 是手机。美式也说 cell phone。形容词 mobile 表示可移动。

definition_en: facts about something
example1_en: The website gives information about bus times.
example1_zh: 网站提供公交时刻的信息。
example2_en: Personal information collected by a school app should not be sold to other companies.
example2_zh: 学校应用收集的个人信息，不该卖给其他公司。
collocations: a piece of information｜一条信息 ; information technology｜信息技术
tip_zh: information 不可数，不说 an information。

definition_en: extremely good
example1_en: We had a super time at the fair.
example1_zh: 我们在义卖上玩得非常开心。
example2_en: A super stadium does not help a town whose school roof still leaks.
example2_zh: 一座超级体育场帮不了校舍屋顶仍在漏雨的城镇。
collocations: super star｜超级明星
tip_zh: super 多用于口语。supermarket 是“超市”。

definition_en: to take in; to hold one's attention
example1_en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
example1_zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

definition_en: a social gathering, or a political group
example1_en: Our class will have a party on Friday evening.
example1_zh: 我们班周五晚上有聚会。
example2_en: A political party that never meets voters outside election season soon loses their trust.
example2_zh: 只在选举季见选民的政党，很快会失去他们的信任。
collocations: birthday party｜生日聚会 ; party member｜党员
tip_zh: party 表示聚会或党派，看语境区分。

meanings_zh: n. 热；高温 | v. 加热
definition_en: the quality of being hot | to make something hot
example1_en: The heat in the lab made everyone thirsty.
example1_zh: 实验室里的高温让每个人都口渴。
example2_en: Cities store heat in roads and roofs, so a park can be cooler than the street beside it.
example2_zh: 城市把热存在路面和屋顶里，所以公园可以比旁边的街道凉快。
collocations: heat wave｜热浪 ; heat up｜加热
tip_zh: heat 作名词通常不可数。作动词是加热。

meanings_zh: n. 外貌；出现 | n. 出现；露面
definition_en: how someone looks; the act of showing up | an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present
example1_en: First appearance can be misleading.
example1_zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。
example2_en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
example2_zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。
collocations: physical appearance｜外貌 ; make an appearance｜露面 ; outward appearance｜外表 ; improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip_zh: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

meanings_zh: n. 中间 | adj. 中间的
definition_en: the centre | in the centre
example1_en: Stand in the middle of the line.
example1_zh: 站在队伍中间。
example2_en: Shops in the middle of a town keep daily life there when a mall opens on the edge.
example2_zh: 当商场开在城边时，镇中心的商店仍维持着那里的日常生活。
collocations: in the middle of｜在……中间
tip_zh: middle 作形容词是“中间的”：middle school。

definition_en: fairly cold, or calm
example1_en: The room is cool in the morning.
example1_zh: 房间早晨很凉快。
example2_en: Cool shade from old trees can matter as much as an air conditioner a school cannot afford.
example2_zh: 老树的凉荫，可以和学校买不起的空调一样重要。
collocations: keep cool｜保持冷静
tip_zh: cool 比 cold 程度轻。口语里也可表示“酷”。

definition_en: the leader of a team or a ship
example1_en: She is captain of the school basketball team.
example1_zh: 她是校篮球队队长。
example2_en: A captain who listens before the match can stop a small argument from becoming a lost game.
example2_zh: 开赛前肯听人说话的队长，能避免小争执变成一场输掉的比赛。
collocations: team captain｜队长 ; captain of the ship｜船长
tip_zh: captain 也可指海军上校或机长，要看语境。

definition_en: a person or team that wins
example1_en: The winner of the race is in Class 2.
example1_zh: 赛跑的获胜者在二班。
example2_en: Naming only one winner can hide a class project that several students built together.
example2_zh: 只点出一个获胜者，可能掩盖几个学生一起完成的课堂项目。
collocations: winner of｜……的获胜者
tip_zh: winner 是人。奖品用 prize 或 award。

definition_en: not difficult
example1_en: The first question is easy.
example1_zh: 第一题很容易。
example2_en: It is easy to blame students for being late when the bus itself never arrives on time.
example2_zh: 当公交本身从不准时，责备学生迟到是容易的。
collocations: take it easy｜别紧张 ; easy to do｜容易做
tip_zh: It is easy for sb to do。

definition_en: an object, fact, or action
example1_en: The first thing I do is open the windows.
example1_zh: 我做的第一件事是开窗。
example2_en: The hardest thing about changing a habit is not the first day but the quiet week that follows.
example2_zh: 改变一个习惯最难的不是第一天，而是之后安静的那一周。
collocations: the thing is｜问题是 ; for one thing｜首先
tip_zh: thing 很宽泛；写作里能用更具体的名词时尽量换掉。

meanings_zh: n. 害怕；恐惧 | v. 害怕
definition_en: the feeling of being afraid | to be afraid of
example1_en: Her fear of the dark road is reasonable.
example1_zh: 她对那条黑路的害怕是合理的。
example2_en: Fear of a late bus should lead a town to change the timetable, not to blame the student.
example2_zh: 对晚点公交的担忧应该促使城镇改时刻表，而不是责备学生。
collocations: for fear of｜生怕 ; in fear｜害怕地
tip_zh: fear 作动词是“害怕”：fear that。

definition_en: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking
example1_en: Cover your mouth when you cough.
example1_zh: 咳嗽时捂住嘴。
example2_en: The mouth of the river is where the town's waste becomes the sea's problem.
example2_zh: 河口是城镇的废物变成海洋问题的地方。
collocations: mouth of a river｜河口
tip_zh: mouth 可指嘴，也可指河口或容器口。

meanings_zh: n. 基础；根据 | n. 方式；频率
definition_en: the main support or reason | The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.
example1_en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
example1_zh: 信任是友谊的基础。
example2_en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
example2_zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。
collocations: on a daily basis｜每天 ; on the basis of｜根据 ; form the basis of｜构成……的基础 ; a sound basis｜坚实的基础
tip_zh: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；研究 | n. 学习；研究
definition_en: to spend time learning | the activity of studying
example1_en: I study English for twenty minutes a day.
example1_zh: 我每天学二十分钟英语。
example2_en: Students study better in a room that is quiet than in one filled with traffic noise.
example2_zh: 学生在安静的房间里比在充满交通噪音的房间里学得更好。
collocations: study for｜为……学习 ; study hard｜努力学习
tip_zh: study 强调系统学习；learn 强调学会。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；代价 | v. 花费
definition_en: the money or effort needed | to have a price
example1_en: The cost of the trip is fifty yuan.
example1_zh: 这次出行的费用是五十元。
example2_en: The cost of dirty air does not appear on a shop receipt, but it appears in hospital visits.
example2_zh: 脏空气的代价不会出现在购物小票上，但会出现在医院就诊里。
collocations: at the cost of｜以……为代价 ; living cost｜生活费用
tip_zh: cost 作动词的过去式仍是 cost。sth costs sb money。

definition_en: any thing at all
example1_en: Is there anything I can do to help?
example1_zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？
example2_en: If a report hides anything important, the public cannot judge whether a project deserves support.
example2_zh: 如果一份报告隐瞒了重要内容，公众就无法判断一个项目是否值得支持。
collocations: anything else｜其他任何事 ; anything but｜根本不
tip_zh: anything 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句中的“某事”用 something。

definition_en: a hot sausage in a long piece of bread
example1_en: He bought a hot dog after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛结束后他买了一个热狗。
example2_en: A hot dog at a school fair is a small sale, and the queue still needs a clear price.
example2_zh: 学校义卖上的热狗是小买卖，队伍前面仍然需要标明清价格。
collocations: hot dog stand｜热狗摊
tip_zh: hot dog 是食物，不是狗。两个词都要写。

definition_en: how big something is
example1_en: What size are these shoes?
example1_zh: 这双鞋是多大尺码？
example2_en: The size of a class changes what one teacher can notice during a lesson.
example2_zh: 班级的大小会改变一位老师在课上能注意到什么。
collocations: size of｜……的大小 ; in size｜在尺寸上
tip_zh: size 前常用 what 提问尺码。

definition_en: of whom or of which
example1_en: Whose bag is this?
example1_zh: 这是谁的包？
example2_en: A town whose only clinic closes will send every night emergency onto a dark road.
example2_zh: 唯一诊所关闭的城镇，会把每个夜间急诊都送到一条黑暗的路上。
collocations: whose book｜谁的书
tip_zh: whose 可指人也可指物，用来表示所属。

definition_en: not large
example1_en: We need a small room for the group discussion.
example1_zh: 小组讨论我们需要一间小房间。
example2_en: A small change in bus times can decide whether a student arrives before the first lesson.
example2_zh: 公交时间的一个小改动，就能决定学生是否赶得上第一节课。
collocations: small talk｜闲聊
tip_zh: small 强调尺寸不大；little 常带感情色彩。

definition_en: the organ of thought
example1_en: Sleep helps the brain keep new words.
example1_zh: 睡眠帮助大脑记住生词。
example2_en: A tired brain makes careless mistakes, which is why a late bus is also a learning problem.
example2_zh: 疲惫的大脑会犯粗心错误，所以晚点的公交也是学习问题。
collocations: brain work｜脑力劳动
tip_zh: brain 是可数名词。

definition_en: a round object used in games, or a formal dance
example1_en: The ball went over the fence.
example1_zh: 球飞过了篱笆。
example2_en: A lost ball is a small cost; a playground with no space to play is a larger one.
example2_zh: 丢一个球是小代价；没有地方玩的操场是更大的代价。
collocations: play ball｜开始合作；打球
tip_zh: ball 表示球是可数名词。

definition_en: special, or one certain thing
example1_en: Is there a particular bus you take?
example1_zh: 你坐某一路特定的公交吗？
example2_en: A particular street may flood every year while the official map still calls the area safe.
example2_zh: 某一条街可能每年都积水，而官方地图仍称该地区安全。
collocations: in particular｜尤其
tip_zh: particular 强调某一个；special 强调与众不同。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；问题 | v. 要紧
definition_en: a subject or situation | to be important
example1_en: This is a serious matter.
example1_zh: 这是一件严肃的事。
example2_en: Housing is not a private matter when high rents push workers far from the jobs a city needs.
example2_zh: 当高房租把工人推离城市需要的工作时，住房就不是私事。
collocations: as a matter of fact｜事实上 ; no matter｜无论 ; What's the matter?｜怎么了？
tip_zh: matter 作动词是“要紧”：It matters。no matter 后接 who、what、how。

definition_en: an organization that provides a service
example1_en: The travel agency changed our train tickets.
example1_zh: 旅行社改了我们的火车票。
example2_en: A housing agency that hides fees makes it harder for young workers to compare real costs.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的房屋中介，会让年轻工人更难比较真实成本。
collocations: travel agency｜旅行社 ; news agency｜通讯社
tip_zh: agency 是机构，agent 是里面办事的人或代理人。

meanings_zh: v. 带领；导致 | n. 领先；铅
definition_en: to guide, or to cause a result | a leading position, or a soft metal
example1_en: The monitor will lead us to the hall.
example1_zh: 班长会带我们去大厅。
example2_en: Poor bus links can lead families to buy cars they can hardly afford.
example2_zh: 糟糕的公交连接会促使家庭去买他们几乎负担不起的汽车。
collocations: lead to｜导致 ; lead a life｜过生活
tip_zh: lead 的过去式和过去分词是 led，不是 leaded。作名词“铅”或“领先”时读音不同。

definition_en: an organised group, or a connection
example1_en: The parents' association paid for the new books.
example1_zh: 家长协会付了新书的钱。
example2_en: The association between night noise and poor sleep is clear in streets beside a main road.
example2_zh: 夜间噪音和睡眠差之间的联系，在主干道旁的街道上很清楚。
collocations: in association with｜与……联合
tip_zh: association 可指组织，也可指事物之间的关联。

definition_en: to start
example1_en: The meeting will begin at eight.
example1_zh: 会议八点开始。
example2_en: Cities should begin flood practice before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
example2_zh: 城市应当在雨季之前开始防汛演练，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。
collocations: begin to do｜开始做 ; begin with｜以……开始
tip_zh: begin 的过去式是 began，过去分词是 begun。to begin with 表示首先。

definition_en: as much or as many as needed
example1_en: There is enough paper for everyone.
example1_zh: 纸够每个人用。
example2_en: It is not enough to build a cycle lane if it ends at the busiest crossing without a light.
example2_zh: 如果自行车道在最繁忙的路口没有信号灯就中断，仅仅修建它是不够的。
collocations: enough to do｜足够做 ; more than enough｜绰绰有余
tip_zh: enough 放在形容词和副词后面：old enough；放在名词前面：enough time。

definition_en: a group of students, a lesson, or a social group
example1_en: Our class meets in Room 12.
example1_zh: 我们班在 12 室上课。
example2_en: A class of forty is hard to teach well if one teacher has no assistant.
example2_zh: 如果一位老师没有助手，四十人的班很难教好。
collocations: in class｜在课堂上 ; after class｜课后 ; class teacher｜班主任
tip_zh: class 表示课堂时 in class 不加 the。

definition_en: a part in a play, or a function
example1_en: She played the role of the teacher in the play.
example1_zh: 她在剧里扮演老师。
example2_en: Buses play a role in school life that a wider road cannot replace.
example2_zh: 公交在学校生活中的作用，是更宽的马路替代不了的。
collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用
tip_zh: play a role in 后接名词或 doing。

definition_en: not many
example1_en: Few students finished the last question.
example1_zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。
example2_en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
example2_zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。
collocations: a few｜一些 ; quite a few｜不少 ; few of｜……中很少
tip_zh: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

definition_en: a nation, or land outside towns
example1_en: Students from five countries joined the online class.
example1_zh: 来自五个国家的学生参加了网课。
example2_en: People leave the country for the city when schools and clinics there are too far apart.
example2_zh: 当乡村的学校和诊所彼此离得太远时，人们会离开乡村去城市。
collocations: in the country｜在乡下 ; developing country｜发展中国家
tip_zh: country 表示国家时可数；the country 常指乡村。

definition_en: to know the meaning of something
example1_en: I understand the question now.
example1_zh: 我现在明白这道题了。
example2_en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
example2_zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。
collocations: make oneself understood｜让别人听懂
tip_zh: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

definition_en: a title used before a man's surname
example1_en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
example1_zh: 李老师八点开始上课。
example2_en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
example2_zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。
collocations: Mr. Smith｜史密斯先生
tip_zh: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

definition_en: safety, or the people who guard a place
example1_en: The school improved security at the gate.
example1_zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。
example2_en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
example2_zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。
collocations: security check｜安全检查 ; a sense of security｜安全感
tip_zh: security 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 文化 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: shared customs and arts | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: Food is part of local culture.
example1_zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。
example2_en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
example2_zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_zh: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

meanings_zh: n. 看法；景色 | v. 观看；视为
definition_en: an opinion, or what can be seen | to look at, or to consider
example1_en: What is your view on the new timetable?
example1_zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？
example2_en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
example2_zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。
collocations: point of view｜观点 ; in view of｜鉴于
tip_zh: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

definition_en: to stop living
example1_en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
example1_zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。
example2_en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
example2_zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。
collocations: die of｜死于 ; die out｜灭绝
tip_zh: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

definition_en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection
example1_en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
example1_zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。
example2_en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
example2_zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。
collocations: take a shot｜拍摄；尝试 ; a shot at｜一次尝试
tip_zh: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

definition_en: acceptable
example1_en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
example1_zh: 我借你的尺子可以吗？
example2_en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
example2_zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。
collocations: be okay｜没问题
tip_zh: okay 与 O.K. 是同一个词。本库只保留 okay。正式写作可用 all right。

meanings_zh: adj. 较年幼的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
definition_en: younger or lower in rank | Intended for younger people or involving them | A younger person, or a student below the final year
example1_en: He is a junior member of the team.
example1_zh: 他是队里的初级成员。
example2_en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
example2_zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。
collocations: junior staff｜初级员工 ; junior position｜初级职位 ; junior championship｜青少年锦标赛
tip_zh: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

definition_en: in a true way, or sincerely
example1_en: I am truly sorry for the delay.
example1_zh: 这次耽误我真的很抱歉。
example2_en: A programme is truly open only when students without a laptop can still take part.
example2_zh: 只有没有笔记本电脑的学生也能参加时，一个项目才真正开放。
collocations: yours truly｜敬上
tip_zh: 信末 Yours truly 是客套结尾。truly 强调真实，不只是程度很高。

definition_en: with each other
example1_en: We cleaned the classroom together.
example1_zh: 我们一起打扫了教室。
example2_en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
example2_zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。
collocations: together with｜和……一起 ; get together｜聚会
tip_zh: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

definition_en: the process of making things, or the amount made
example1_en: Food production fell after the dry month.
example1_zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。
example2_en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
example2_zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。
collocations: in production｜在生产中
tip_zh: production 通常不可数。

definition_en: a place, a job, or an opinion
example1_en: Write your position in the team on the form.
example1_zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。
example2_en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
example2_zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。
collocations: in a position to｜能够 ; take a position｜采取立场
tip_zh: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 棕色的 | n. 棕色
definition_en: of the colour of earth or coffee | the colour brown
example1_en: He carried a brown bag.
example1_zh: 他拿着一个棕色的包。
example2_en: Brown flood water in a street is a warning, not a picture to share without context.
example2_zh: 街上的棕色洪水是警报，不是可以不说明背景就转发的照片。
collocations: brown eyes｜棕色眼睛
tip_zh: brown 也可作名词表示棕色。

definition_en: to use money or time
example1_en: I spend twenty minutes on new words.
example1_zh: 我花二十分钟学生词。
example2_en: Families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
example2_zh: 物价上涨时，家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。
collocations: spend time doing｜花时间做 ; spend money on｜在……上花钱
tip_zh: spend 的主语是人。It takes time 的主语是事物。过去式是 spent。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助 | n. 帮助
definition_en: to make it easier for someone to do something | the act of helping
example1_en: Could you help me move this desk?
example1_zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？
example2_en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
example2_zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。
collocations: help sb with｜在某方面帮助 ; with the help of｜在……帮助下 ; can't help doing｜忍不住
tip_zh: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

definition_en: tall, or great in amount or level
example1_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example1_zh: 架子太高，我够不着。
example2_en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
example2_zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。
collocations: high school｜中学 ; at a high speed｜高速
tip_zh: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

definition_en: a person who does office work or keeps records
example1_en: The club secretary wrote the minutes.
example1_zh: 社团秘书写了会议记录。
example2_en: A school secretary often knows which families cannot be reached by phone.
example2_zh: 学校秘书常常知道哪些家庭用电话联系不上。
collocations: secretary of｜……的秘书
tip_zh: secretary 的复数是 secretaries。

definition_en: how fast something moves
example1_en: The car was travelling at a high speed.
example1_zh: 汽车在高速行驶。
example2_en: Lower speed near a school protects children more than a wider road does.
example2_zh: 学校附近降低速度，比把路修得更宽更能保护孩子。
collocations: at a speed of｜以……的速度 ; speed up｜加速
tip_zh: speed 作动词是“加速”，过去式可以是 sped。

meanings_zh: n. 平均数；一般水平 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: the usual level or mean | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: His scores are above the average.
example1_zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。
example2_en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
example2_zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_zh: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

definition_en: to decide which one you want
example1_en: Choose a question you can explain.
example1_zh: 选一道你能解释的题。
example2_en: Families choose a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
example2_zh: 家庭选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。
collocations: choose to do｜选择做 ; choose between｜在……之间选择
tip_zh: choose 的过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen。

definition_en: a film
example1_en: We saw a movie about a small town.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于小镇的电影。
example2_en: A movie can show a problem, but the town still has to decide what to do on Monday.
example2_zh: 电影可以展示一个问题，但城镇仍要决定星期一做什么。
collocations: go to the movies｜去看电影 ; movie star｜电影明星
tip_zh: movie 是美式常用词；英式更常说 film。

definition_en: happening often, or shared
example1_en: Colds are common in winter.
example1_zh: 冬天感冒很常见。
example2_en: A common timetable for buses and schools would stop students waiting in the dark.
example2_zh: 公交和学校共用的时刻表，能避免学生在黑暗中等候。
collocations: in common｜共同的 ; common sense｜常识
tip_zh: common 强调经常发生或共有；ordinary 强调平凡、不特别。

definition_en: to think that something is true
example1_en: I believe we can finish the project tonight.
example1_zh: 我相信我们今晚能做完这个项目。
example2_en: Students should not believe a chart until they know who collected the numbers and why.
example2_zh: 学生在弄清数字是谁收集的、为什么收集之前，不该轻信一张图表。
collocations: believe in｜信任；信仰 ; believe it or not｜信不信由你
tip_zh: believe 后接 that 从句或 sb；believe in 表示信任或信仰。

meanings_zh: n. 火车 | v. 训练
definition_en: a railway vehicle | to teach a skill
example1_en: The train leaves at seven.
example1_zh: 火车七点开。
example2_en: A late train can make a student miss the first lesson even when the school itself starts on time.
example2_zh: 晚点的火车会让学生错过第一节课，即使学校本身准时开始。
collocations: by train｜乘火车 ; train station｜火车站
tip_zh: train 作动词是“训练”。

definition_en: thin material for writing, or a newspaper
example1_en: Write your name on the paper.
example1_zh: 把名字写在纸上。
example2_en: A paper exam in a hot room measures heat as well as knowledge.
example2_zh: 炎热房间里的纸笔考试，测量的不只是知识，还有热。
collocations: a piece of paper｜一张纸 ; on paper｜在纸面上
tip_zh: paper 表示纸张时不可数。a paper 可以是一份报纸或一篇论文。

definition_en: large in size or importance
example1_en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
example1_zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。
example2_en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
example2_zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。
collocations: a big deal｜一件大事
tip_zh: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

definition_en: the part of the body at the end of the arm | to pass something to someone
example1_en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
example1_zh: 发言前请举手。
example2_en: A helping hand from an older student can matter more than another printed worksheet.
example2_zh: 高年级学生伸来的一只援手，可能比又一张打印的练习纸更重要。
collocations: by hand｜用手 ; on the one hand｜一方面 ; give sb a hand｜帮忙
tip_zh: hand in 是上交。hand 作动词是“递”。

meanings_zh: adj. 女的；雌的 | n. 女性；雌性
definition_en: of the sex that can produce young | a female person or animal
example1_en: The form has a box for male or female.
example1_zh: 表格上有男或女的一栏。
example2_en: A female engineer visiting the class shows a possible job, not only a word in a textbook.
example2_zh: 一位女工程师来到班上，展示的是一种可能的工作，而不只是课本里的一个词。
collocations: female student｜女学生
tip_zh: female 可作形容词或名词。填写表格时表示性别。

definition_en: a large amount, or ordinary people as a group
example1_en: A mass of leaves blocked the drain.
example1_zh: 一大堆叶子堵住了排水口。
example2_en: The masses use the early bus, so a fare rise hits them before it hits anyone with a car.
example2_zh: 普通大众坐早班车，所以票价上涨先打击他们，而不是有车的人。
collocations: a mass of｜大量 ; the masses｜群众
tip_zh: a mass of 后可接可数或不可数名词。the masses 指广大民众。

definition_en: to form a picture in the mind
example1_en: Imagine a street where children can walk safely.
example1_zh: 想象一条孩子可以安全走路的街。
example2_en: It is hard to imagine a later school start unless the buses change too.
example2_zh: 除非公交也改时间，否则很难想象推迟上学。
collocations: imagine doing｜想象做
tip_zh: imagine 后接名词、doing 或 that 从句。

definition_en: having a lot of money, or full of something
example1_en: The soil here is rich and good for vegetables.
example1_zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，适合种菜。
example2_en: A rich city can still have neighbourhoods where children share one small room.
example2_zh: 富裕的城市里，仍可能有孩子合住一间小屋的社区。
collocations: rich in｜富含 ; the rich｜富人
tip_zh: the rich 表示一类人。rich in 后接所富含的东西。

meanings_zh: n. 影响 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to change someone or something | to change how someone thinks or acts
example1_en: His teacher had a strong influence on him.
example1_zh: 老师对他影响很大。
example2_en: Peer influence can push a student toward a club or away from one.
example2_zh: 同伴的影响可以把学生推向一个社团，也可以把他们推开。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; under the influence of｜在……影响下
tip_zh: influence 后接 on。作动词时直接接宾语：influence somebody。

definition_en: what something is made of, or information for a piece of work
example1_en: The bag is made of recycled material.
example1_zh: 这个包是用回收材料做的。
example2_en: Teaching material about floods should include the streets children actually use.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的教材应该包括孩子真正走的那些街。
collocations: raw material｜原材料 ; reading material｜阅读材料
tip_zh: material 作“材料”时可数或不可数。作形容词是“物质的”。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；出价 | n. 提供；出价
definition_en: to say you will give or do something | a proposal to give or pay
example1_en: The library offers a quiet room after school.
example1_zh: 图书馆放学后提供一间安静的房间。
example2_en: Towns that offer night buses help workers who finish after the regular service stops.
example2_zh: 提供夜班公交的城镇，帮助那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人。
collocations: offer to do｜主动提出做 ; offer sb sth｜向某人提供
tip_zh: offer 后可接 to do 或双宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 居住；生活 | adj. 现场的；活的
definition_en: to have one's home, or to be alive | happening now, or alive
example1_en: We live near the old market.
example1_zh: 我们住在旧市场附近。
example2_en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
example2_zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。
collocations: live on｜以……为生 ; live up to｜不辜负
tip_zh: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

meanings_zh: n. 种类 | v. 分类
definition_en: a type | to arrange into groups
example1_en: What sort of book do you want?
example1_zh: 你想要哪一种书？
example2_en: The sort of food sold at the gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
example2_zh: 门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。
collocations: sort of｜有点儿；某种 ; all sorts of｜各种各样
tip_zh: sort 作动词是“分类”。

definition_en: a planned piece of work
example1_en: Our project is about the river behind the school.
example1_zh: 我们的课题是关于学校后面的河。
example2_en: A project that never asks local people can solve the wrong problem.
example2_zh: 从不询问当地人的项目，可能会解决一个错误的问题。
collocations: project work｜课题作业
tip_zh: project 作名词重音常在前；作动词“投射、预计”时重音常在后。

definition_en: liked by many people
example1_en: The reading club is popular this term.
example1_zh: 读书社团这学期很受欢迎。
example2_en: A popular beach can damage the very coast people come to see.
example2_zh: 受欢迎的海滩可能破坏人们前来观看的那片海岸。
collocations: be popular with｜受……欢迎
tip_zh: popular 后接 with 表示受某类人欢迎。

definition_en: done in a short time
example1_en: We had a quick review before the test.
example1_zh: 测验前我们快速复习了一下。
example2_en: A quick warning is useless if the path to higher ground is not marked.
example2_zh: 如果通往高地的路没有标出，快速的警报也没有用。
collocations: be quick｜快点
tip_zh: quick 的副词是 quickly。fast 本身可作副词。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；在对面 | adv. 横过
definition_en: from one side to the other | from one side to the other
example1_en: There is a bookshop across the street.
example1_zh: 街对面有一家书店。
example2_en: A bridge across the river can cut a student's journey from an hour to ten minutes.
example2_zh: 河上的一座桥可以把学生的路程从一小时缩短到十分钟。
collocations: come across｜偶然遇见 ; across from｜在……对面
tip_zh: across 强调从表面一边到另一边；through 强调从内部穿过。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；岗位；柱 | v. 邮寄；张贴
definition_en: mail, a job, or a pole | to send by mail, or to put up a notice
example1_en: I will send the form by post.
example1_zh: 我会把表格寄出。
example2_en: A post in a village school is hard to fill if the teacher must travel two hours each way.
example2_zh: 如果老师每天要单程走两小时，乡村学校的岗位就很难有人来。
collocations: post office｜邮局 ; by post｜邮寄
tip_zh: post 作动词是“邮寄”或“张贴”。美式邮件多用 mail。

definition_en: a container of soft material
example1_en: My bag is under the desk.
example1_zh: 我的包在桌子下面。
example2_en: A clear bag rule at the gate should still leave room for a student's medicine.
example2_zh: 门口的透明包规定，仍应当给学生的药留出位置。
collocations: school bag｜书包 ; a bag of｜一袋
tip_zh: bag 可数。a bag of 后接所装的东西。

meanings_zh: v. 适合；合身 | adj. 健康的；适合的
definition_en: to be the right size or kind | healthy, or suitable
example1_en: These shoes do not fit.
example1_zh: 这双鞋不合脚。
example2_en: A school timetable should fit the buses, or students will arrive after the lesson has started.
example2_zh: 课表应该配合公交，否则学生会在课开始后才到。
collocations: fit in｜适应 ; keep fit｜保持健康
tip_zh: fit 作形容词是“健康的”或“适合的”。过去式可以是 fitted。

definition_en: usual and expected
example1_en: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
example1_zh: 考试前紧张是正常的。
example2_en: A normal school day becomes unsafe when the road outside has no pavement.
example2_zh: 当外面的路没有人行道时，普通的上学日会变得不安全。
collocations: normal temperature｜正常体温 ; return to normal｜恢复正常
tip_zh: normal 是形容词；normally 是副词。

meanings_zh: v. 考虑；认为 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think about carefully | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
example1_zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。
example2_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
example2_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

definition_en: trust in paying later, a school unit, or praise
example1_en: She got extra credit for the project.
example1_zh: 她因这个课题得到了额外学分。
example2_en: Credit for a cleaner river belongs to the people who stopped the waste, not only to the speech.
example2_zh: 把河变干净的功劳属于制止排污的人，而不只属于那篇讲话。
collocations: credit card｜信用卡 ; to one's credit｜值得表扬
tip_zh: credit 的几个义要靠搭配区分。

meanings_zh: v. 通过；传递；经过 | n. 通行证；及格
definition_en: to succeed, hand over, or go by | a permit, or a successful result
example1_en: I hope to pass the listening test.
example1_zh: 我希望通过听力测验。
example2_en: Students who pass a crowded junction every morning need a light, not only a higher test score.
example2_zh: 每天早晨经过拥挤路口的学生需要一盏灯，而不只是更高的考分。
collocations: pass on｜传递 ; pass by｜经过
tip_zh: pass 的过去式是 passed。past 是介词或名词，不要拼混。

definition_en: belonging to a king or queen
example1_en: The royal garden is open on Sunday.
example1_zh: 皇家花园周日开放。
example2_en: A royal visit fills the news, while the town's ordinary market still has to open on Monday.
example2_zh: 王室来访会占满新闻，而镇上的普通集市周一仍然得开。
collocations: the royal family｜王室
tip_zh: royal 是形容词。国王或女王用 king、queen。

meanings_zh: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: usual weather of a place | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: The climate here is warm and wet.
example1_zh: 这里的气候温暖潮湿。
example2_en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
example2_zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_zh: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

definition_en: a small animal often kept as a pet
example1_en: The cat sleeps in the sunny window.
example1_zh: 猫睡在有阳光的窗台上。
example2_en: A school rule about the office cat should say who feeds it on holiday.
example2_zh: 关于办公室那只猫的规定，应当写明假期谁喂它。
collocations: pet cat｜宠物猫
tip_zh: cat 可数。雄猫是 tomcat，小猫是 kitten。

definition_en: a location, or a position
example1_en: This is a good place to wait for the bus.
example1_zh: 这是等公交的好地方。
example2_en: Every child needs a place to study that is safe, even if that place is a shared table.
example2_zh: 每个孩子都需要一个安全的学习地方，哪怕那只是一张共用的桌子。
collocations: take place｜发生 ; in place of｜代替 ; from place to place｜到处
tip_zh: take place 表示发生，没有被动语态。

definition_en: a road vehicle with an engine
example1_en: My uncle drives a small car to work.
example1_zh: 我叔叔开一辆小汽车上班。
example2_en: Fewer car trips to school would clear the air on the narrow street outside the gate.
example2_zh: 减少开车上学的次数，能改善校门外窄街上的空气。
collocations: by car｜乘汽车 ; car park｜停车场
tip_zh: by car 不加冠词。

definition_en: a flat piece of wood, or a group that directs an organisation
example1_en: The teacher wrote the date on the board.
example1_zh: 老师把日期写在黑板上。
example2_en: A school board that never visits classrooms may not see why a class of forty is hard to teach.
example2_zh: 从不进教室的校董会，可能看不到四十人的班为什么难教。
collocations: on board｜在船/车上 ; notice board｜布告栏
tip_zh: board 作动词是“上船、上车”。

definition_en: to stop and hold, to be in time, or to get an illness
example1_en: Catch the ball with both hands.
example1_zh: 用双手接球。
example2_en: Students who catch the early bus avoid the crowd that builds up outside the gate.
example2_zh: 赶上早班车的学生，可以避开校门口越聚越多的人。
collocations: catch a cold｜感冒 ; catch up with｜赶上
tip_zh: catch 的过去式和过去分词是 caught。catch up with 表示追上。

definition_en: a plan of action by a government or organisation
example1_en: The new policy limits cars near the school.
example1_zh: 新政策限制学校附近的汽车。
example2_en: A housing policy that ignores bus routes pushes workers farther from their jobs.
example2_zh: 忽视公交线路的住房政策，会把工人推得离工作更远。
collocations: foreign policy｜外交政策
tip_zh: policy 是可数名词：a policy。politics 是“政治”。

meanings_zh: v. 爱；喜爱 | n. 爱
definition_en: to feel deep affection, or to like very much | a strong feeling of affection
example1_en: I love the smell of the library in the morning.
example1_zh: 我喜欢早晨图书馆的气味。
example2_en: People who love a place are often the first to notice when its river or dialect is disappearing.
example2_zh: 热爱一个地方的人，往往最先注意到它的河流或方言正在消失。
collocations: love doing｜喜欢做 ; fall in love｜爱上
tip_zh: love 后可接 doing 或 to do，口语里 doing 更常见。

definition_en: a place, or a small mark
example1_en: This spot by the window is good for reading.
example1_zh: 窗边这个位置适合读书。
example2_en: A quiet spot in a noisy city can matter as much as a large park that is hard to reach.
example2_zh: 喧闹城市里一个安静的角落，可能和一座难以到达的大公园一样重要。
collocations: on the spot｜当场 ; a spot of｜少量
tip_zh: spot 作动词是“发现”或“弄上污点”。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；表明 | n. 演出；展览
definition_en: to let someone see, or to prove | a public performance or display
example1_en: Show me your ticket, please.
example1_zh: 请出示你的票。
example2_en: The data show that night markets bring noise as well as income to the streets around them.
example2_zh: 数据表明，夜市给周围街道带来收入的同时，也带来噪音。
collocations: show up｜出现 ; show sb around｜带某人参观 ; on show｜在展出
tip_zh: show sb sth 双宾语；过去分词是 shown。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；超过 | adv. 在上面
definition_en: higher than, or more than | in a higher place
example1_en: The clock is above the door.
example1_zh: 钟在门的上方。
example2_en: Temperatures above forty degrees make outdoor sports unsafe for younger students.
example2_zh: 超过四十度的气温会让低龄学生的户外运动不安全。
collocations: above all｜尤其 ; above sea level｜海拔
tip_zh: above 强调位置更高，不一定垂直；over 常有“正上方”或“越过”的意思。

definition_en: to get something by paying money
example1_en: I will buy a notebook after class.
example1_zh: 课后我去买一本笔记本。
example2_en: Families buy less fresh food when the nearest market is an hour away by bus.
example2_zh: 当最近的市场要坐一小时公交时，家庭会少买新鲜食物。
collocations: buy sb sth｜给某人买 ; buy from｜从……购买
tip_zh: buy 的过去式和过去分词是 bought。

definition_en: not long, or not tall
example1_en: It is a short walk from here to the gate.
example1_zh: 从这里到门口走路不远。
example2_en: Short breaks between lessons help attention more than one long break at the end of the day.
example2_zh: 课间的短休息比一天结束时一次长休息更有助于注意力。
collocations: in short｜简言之 ; be short of｜缺少 ; short of｜缺乏
tip_zh: short 可指时间、长度或身材。shortly 是“不久”，不是“短地”。

definition_en: by way of
example1_en: We came via the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们经由旧桥过来。
example2_en: News via a phone app is fast, but a named source is still necessary.
example2_zh: 通过手机应用传来的新闻很快，但署名的来源仍然必要。
collocations: via the Internet｜通过互联网
tip_zh: via 是介词，后接名词，多用于书面。

definition_en: to have clothes or glasses on the body
example1_en: Wear glasses in the lab.
example1_zh: 在实验室里戴眼镜。
example2_en: Students wear the same uniform, but their journeys to school are not the same length.
example2_zh: 学生穿同样的校服，但他们上学的路程并不一样长。
collocations: wear out｜穿破 ; wear glasses｜戴眼镜
tip_zh: wear 表示穿着的状态；put on 表示穿上的动作。过去式是 wore。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道 | v. 报告；报道
definition_en: a spoken or written account | to give an account of
example1_en: Please hand in the lab report tomorrow.
example1_zh: 请明天交实验报告。
example2_en: A news report should show what is certain and what is still only a claim.
example2_zh: 新闻报道应该标明哪些是确定的，哪些仍只是说法。
collocations: weather report｜天气预报 ; report on｜关于……的报告
tip_zh: report 作动词是“报告”或“举报”：report sth to sb。

meanings_zh: v. 覆盖；包括；报道 | n. 封面；盖子
definition_en: to put over, include, or report | the outside of a book, or a lid
example1_en: The map covers the whole town.
example1_zh: 这张地图覆盖整个城镇。
example2_en: News that covers only the city centre misses the villages where the flood starts.
example2_zh: 只报道市中心的新闻，会漏掉洪水开始的那些村子。
collocations: cover with｜用……覆盖 ; be covered with｜被……覆盖
tip_zh: cover 作名词是“封面”或“覆盖物”。

definition_en: bravery
example1_en: It takes courage to speak in public.
example1_zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。
example2_en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_zh: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

meanings_zh: v. 处理 | n. 把手
definition_en: to deal with a situation | the part you hold
example1_en: She can handle the tickets for the trip.
example1_zh: 她能处理这次出行的票。
example2_en: Teachers handle a sudden illness better when the clinic number is on the wall.
example2_zh: 当医务室电话写在墙上时，老师能更好地处理突发疾病。
collocations: handle a problem｜处理问题
tip_zh: handle 作名词是“把手”。作动词是处理或用手操作。

meanings_zh: n. 交换；交流 | v. 交换
definition_en: the act of giving one thing and receiving another | to give something and receive something else
example1_en: The language exchange meets on Thursday.
example1_zh: 语言交流活动周四举行。
example2_en: A fair exchange of ideas needs time for the quieter student to answer.
example2_zh: 公平的思想交流需要时间，让较安静的学生也能回答。
collocations: in exchange for｜作为对……的交换 ; exchange student｜交换生
tip_zh: exchange 作动词时，说 exchange A for B。

definition_en: money in coins or notes
example1_en: I paid in cash.
example1_zh: 我用现金付了款。
example2_en: A market that only takes cash still serves people who have no bank card.
example2_zh: 只收现金的市场，仍然服务没有银行卡的人。
collocations: in cash｜用现金 ; cash desk｜收银台
tip_zh: cash 不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 参观；拜访 | n. 参观；拜访
definition_en: to go to see a person or place | an act of visiting
example1_en: We will visit the museum on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们周五去参观博物馆。
example2_en: Leaders who visit a flooded street themselves ask better questions than those who only read a report.
example2_zh: 亲自走访积水街道的负责人，比只读报告的人问出更好的问题。
collocations: pay a visit｜拜访 ; visit to｜对……的访问
tip_zh: visit 可作动词或名词：a visit to。

meanings_zh: v. 防守；辩护 | v. 辩护；捍卫 | v. 防守
definition_en: to protect from attack | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example1_en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
example1_zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。
example2_en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
example2_zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。
collocations: defend against attack｜抵御攻击 ; defend human rights｜捍卫人权 ; defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；听众 | n. 读者群；受众
definition_en: people watching or listening | People who read or receive particular content
example1_en: The audience clapped after the show.
example1_zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。
example2_en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
example2_zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。
collocations: a large audience｜众多观众 ; a target audience｜目标受众 ; reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众 ; audience participation｜观众参与
tip_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

definition_en: every person
example1_en: Everyone in our class has a reading partner.
example1_zh: 我们班每个人都有阅读伙伴。
example2_en: A park that looks open to everyone may still be hard to reach for people who use wheelchairs.
example2_zh: 一座看起来对所有人开放的公园，对使用轮椅的人仍可能很难到达。
collocations: everyone else｜其他所有人
tip_zh: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: not correct
example1_en: I put the wrong date on the form.
example1_zh: 我在表格上写错了日期。
example2_en: It is wrong to judge a school only by one test if many students arrive already behind.
example2_zh: 如果许多学生入学时已经落后，只用一次考试评价学校是不对的。
collocations: go wrong｜出毛病 ; be wrong with｜……有毛病
tip_zh: wrong 作副词较少；做错事常用 do wrong 或副词 wrongly。

definition_en: the physical world, or a person's character
example1_en: We walked in nature after the rain.
example1_zh: 雨后我们在大自然里走了走。
example2_en: Protecting nature along a river also protects the drinking water of the next town.
example2_zh: 保护河边的自然，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。
collocations: by nature｜本性上 ; in nature｜在自然界
tip_zh: nature 通常不可数。

definition_en: something difficult that needs to be dealt with
example1_en: The main problem is the noise from the road.
example1_zh: 主要问题是路上的噪音。
example2_en: A traffic problem will not disappear if a city only widens the same road again.
example2_zh: 如果一座城市只是再次拓宽同一条路，交通问题不会消失。
collocations: no problem｜没问题 ; solve a problem｜解决问题
tip_zh: problem 是可数名词。question 是提出的问题；problem 是需要解决的困难。

definition_en: a thick liquid used for fuel or cooking
example1_en: The bus uses less oil after the new route.
example1_zh: 新线路之后这辆公交更省油。
example2_en: Dependence on oil makes a town's bus fares rise whenever the world price jumps.
example2_zh: 对石油的依赖会让城镇的公交票价在世界油价跳跃时上涨。
collocations: oil price｜油价
tip_zh: oil 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 钥匙；关键 | adj. 关键的
definition_en: a metal piece for a lock, or the most important thing | most important
example1_en: I left my key in the classroom.
example1_zh: 我把钥匙落在教室了。
example2_en: The key to a later school start is a bus timetable that changes with it.
example2_zh: 推迟上学时间的关键，是一份随之改变的公交时刻表。
collocations: the key to｜……的关键 ; key word｜关键词
tip_zh: the key to 后接名词或 doing，介词是 to。

definition_en: to say words, or to talk a language
example1_en: She can speak English and Chinese.
example1_zh: 她会说英语和中文。
example2_en: Leaders who speak only to cameras miss the questions people ask at the bus stop.
example2_zh: 只对镜头说话的负责人，听不到人们在车站提出的问题。
collocations: speak to｜对……说 ; speak English｜说英语
tip_zh: 说某种语言用 speak，不说 say English。

meanings_zh: n. 攻击；发作 | v. 攻击
definition_en: a violent act, or a sudden illness | to try to hurt or criticise
example1_en: The article is an attack on the new plan, not a description of it.
example1_zh: 这篇文章是对新计划的抨击，不是对它的描述。
example2_en: A heart attack far from a clinic is more dangerous than the same illness near one.
example2_zh: 远离诊所的心脏病发作，比在诊所附近更危险。
collocations: heart attack｜心脏病发作 ; under attack｜受到攻击
tip_zh: attack 作动词直接接宾语，不加 to。

definition_en: not able to happen or be done
example1_en: It is impossible to finish this in one minute.
example1_zh: 一分钟内完成这件事是不可能的。
example2_en: A timetable that looks impossible on paper may still work if two classes share a room.
example2_zh: 纸上看起来不可能的课表，如果两个班共用一间教室，仍可能行得通。
collocations: impossible to do｜不可能做
tip_zh: 说 It is impossible to do，不说 somebody is impossible to do。

definition_en: in front, or in the future
example1_en: The museum is just ahead.
example1_zh: 博物馆就在前面。
example2_en: Planning ahead for a flood is cheaper than repairing the same street every year.
example2_zh: 提前为洪水做计划，比每年修补同一条街更省。
collocations: ahead of｜在……前面 ; go ahead｜前进；请吧
tip_zh: ahead 是副词，不直接接宾语；要接宾语用 ahead of。

definition_en: to look at and understand written words
example1_en: I read the notice twice to be sure.
example1_zh: 我把通知读了两遍以确认。
example2_en: Children who read with an adult at home often arrive at school ready to enjoy longer books.
example2_zh: 在家有成年人和他们一起阅读的孩子，上学时往往已经准备好享受更长的书。
collocations: read aloud｜朗读 ; read through｜通读
tip_zh: read 的过去式和过去分词与原形拼写相同，但读作 /red/。

meanings_zh: v. 注意到 | n. 通知；注意
definition_en: to become aware of something | a written announcement, or attention
example1_en: Did you notice the new timetable?
example1_zh: 你注意到新课表了吗？
example2_en: Teachers notice when a usually loud student becomes quiet for several days.
example2_zh: 一个平时很闹的学生连续几天变安静时，老师会注意到。
collocations: notice board｜布告栏 ; take notice of｜留意
tip_zh: notice 后可接名词或 that 从句。布告栏上的那张纸也叫 notice。

definition_en: very likely
example1_en: She will probably arrive before eight.
example1_zh: 她大概会在八点前到。
example2_en: A town will probably lose young workers if the only jobs are in a city two hours away.
example2_zh: 如果仅有的工作在两小时外的城市，城镇很可能会失去年轻工人。
collocations: most probably｜最可能
tip_zh: probably 是副词；形容词是 probable。

definition_en: used to stress that something is true
example1_en: The lab is small indeed, but it is clean.
example1_zh: 实验室确实小，但很干净。
example2_en: The path is longer, and it is indeed safer when the main road is icy.
example2_zh: 这条路更长，主路结冰时它确实更安全。
collocations: very useful indeed｜确实很有用
tip_zh: indeed 用来加强已经说过的话，多放在形容词或句末。

definition_en: to work out a number
example1_en: Can you calculate the total cost?
example1_zh: 你能算出总费用吗？

meanings_zh: n. 测试；试验 | v. 测试
definition_en: an exam, or a trial | to check something
example1_en: We have a short test on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们周五有一次小测。
example2_en: A listening test taken in a noisy hall does not measure what students can hear in a quiet room.
example2_zh: 在嘈杂大厅里进行的听力测试，测不出学生在安静房间里能听见什么。
collocations: test paper｜试卷 ; pass a test｜通过测试
tip_zh: test 作动词是“测试”。

definition_en: a title used before a married woman's surname
example1_en: Mrs. Chen teaches Class 3 this term.
example1_zh: 陈老师这学期教三班。
example2_en: On an official form, Mrs. shows a title, and it should match the name the family actually uses.
example2_zh: 在正式表格上，Mrs. 是称谓，应当和家里实际使用的姓名一致。
collocations: Mrs. Smith｜史密斯夫人
tip_zh: Mrs. 后接姓，用于已婚女性。Mr. 已在本库单独列出。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；丢下；下降 | n. 滴；下降
definition_en: to fall, or to let something fall | a small amount of liquid, or a fall
example1_en: Do not drop litter in the corridor.
example1_zh: 不要在走廊里丢垃圾。
example2_en: If bus fares drop, more students can reach the school they were offered.
example2_zh: 如果公交票价下降，更多学生能到达录取他们的学校。
collocations: drop in｜顺便拜访 ; drop out｜退出
tip_zh: drop 可作及物或不及物动词。

meanings_zh: n. 状态；国家；州 | v. 陈述
definition_en: a condition, or a country or region | to say or write something clearly
example1_en: The classroom was in a tidy state after the meeting.
example1_zh: 会后教室很整洁。
example2_en: A state that invests in rural schools narrows the gap between villages and big cities.
example2_zh: 投资乡村学校的国家，会缩小乡村与大城市之间的差距。
collocations: in a state of｜处于……状态 ; state-owned｜国有的
tip_zh: the United States 中的 state 是州；泛指国家时也可作 state。

definition_en: of the body, or of physics
example1_en: Physical exercise is part of the school day.
example1_zh: 体育锻炼是上学日的一部分。
example2_en: Physical distance from a clinic becomes dangerous at night, when taxis are scarce.
example2_zh: 夜里出租车稀少时，离诊所的实际距离会变得危险。
collocations: physical education｜体育 ; physical health｜身体健康
tip_zh: physical 可指身体或物理。physics 是学科“物理”。

definition_en: one more time
example1_en: Please read the sentence again, more slowly.
example1_zh: 请再读一遍这个句子，慢一点。
example2_en: If the same street floods again, the town should stop calling it bad luck and fix the drains.
example2_zh: 如果同一条街再次积水，城镇就不该再称之为运气不好，而应修排水系统。
collocations: again and again｜一再 ; once again｜再次
tip_zh: again 不与 repeat 叠用；repeat 本身已有“再做一次”的意思。

meanings_zh: v. 分享；分担 | n. 一份；份额
definition_en: to use or have something with others | a part of something
example1_en: We share one microscope in the lab.
example1_zh: 实验室里我们共用一台显微镜。
example2_en: Neighbours who share tools spend less and throw fewer things away.
example2_zh: 共用工具的邻居花得更少，扔掉的东西也更少。
collocations: share sth with sb｜与某人分享 ; share in｜分担
tip_zh: share 可作及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

definition_en: related to medicine or treatment
example1_en: She hopes to do medical work in a village.
example1_zh: 她希望在乡村做医疗工作。
example2_en: Medical care that exists only in the city leaves village families travelling for hours.
example2_zh: 只存在于城市的医疗，会让乡村家庭赶几小时的路。
collocations: medical care｜医疗 ; medical examination｜体检
tip_zh: medical 是形容词；medicine 是名词“药”或“医学”。

definition_en: to rest on a chair or the ground
example1_en: Please sit near the window if you need light.
example1_zh: 如果你需要光线，请坐在靠窗的地方。
example2_en: Students who sit in the same seat all term may never meet the classmates behind them.
example2_zh: 整个学期都坐同一座位的学生，可能始终认识不到身后的同学。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; sit an exam｜参加考试
tip_zh: sit 的过去式和过去分词都是 sat。坐下常用 sit down。

meanings_zh: v. 穿过；交叉 | n. 十字；交叉 | adj. 生气的
definition_en: to go from one side to the other | a mark or a place where things meet | angry
example1_en: Cross the road at the lights.
example1_zh: 在红绿灯处过马路。
example2_en: Children cross a busy road more safely when the light gives them enough time.
example2_zh: 当信号灯给足时间时，孩子过繁忙的马路会更安全。
collocations: cross out｜划掉
tip_zh: cross 是动词；across 是介词。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难 | n. 彻底的失败；糟糕的事
definition_en: a sudden serious event causing harm | Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.
example1_en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
example1_zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。
example2_en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
example2_zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。
collocations: natural disaster｜自然灾害 ; disaster relief｜灾害救援 ; avert disaster｜避免灾难 ; a complete disaster｜彻底的失败
tip_zh: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

definition_en: a period in a process, or a platform for performers
example1_en: We are at the first stage of the project.
example1_zh: 我们处在项目的第一阶段。
example2_en: The stage of a plan that nobody checks is often the one that fails in the rain.
example2_zh: 计划中没人检查的那个阶段，往往是在雨里失败的阶段。
collocations: on the stage｜在舞台上 ; at this stage｜在这个阶段
tip_zh: stage 作动词是“上演”。

meanings_zh: n. 座位 | v. 使坐下；容纳
definition_en: a place to sit | to give someone a place to sit, or to have room for
example1_en: Is this seat free?
example1_zh: 这个座位有人吗？
example2_en: A reserved seat on the bus matters for a student who cannot stand the whole way.
example2_zh: 公交上的预留座位，对不能全程站着的学生很重要。
collocations: take a seat｜坐下 ; book a seat｜订座
tip_zh: seat 作动词是“使就座”，如 seat 30 people。

definition_en: towards the front
example1_en: Please step forward when your name is called.
example1_zh: 叫到你的名字时请向前走。
example2_en: Looking forward without asking residents can put a new road through the only playground.
example2_zh: 不询问居民就向前规划，可能会让新路穿过唯一的操场。
collocations: look forward to｜期待 ; put forward｜提出
tip_zh: look forward to 后接名词或 doing。

definition_en: a small container for drinks, or a prize
example1_en: There is a cup of tea on the desk.
example1_zh: 桌上有一杯茶。
example2_en: Winning a cup brings a town one happy evening, not a clinic or a bus.
example2_zh: 赢得奖杯给城镇带来一个快乐的晚上，而不是诊所或公交。
collocations: a cup of｜一杯 ; World Cup｜世界杯
tip_zh: a cup of 后接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 电影；胶卷 | v. 拍摄
definition_en: a moving picture, or thin material for cameras | to record moving pictures
example1_en: We watched a short film about the town.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于这个城镇的短片。
example2_en: A film about a flood can move people, but it does not repair the broken drain.
example2_zh: 一部关于洪水的电影可以打动人，但修不好破损的排水管。
collocations: see a film｜看电影 ; film star｜电影明星
tip_zh: 英式常用 film，美式常用 movie。

definition_en: a standard, height, or rank
example1_en: Her reading level has improved this term.
example1_zh: 她的阅读水平这学期提高了。
example2_en: Noise levels beside a main road can be high enough to disturb an open classroom window.
example2_zh: 主干道旁的噪音水平可以高到打扰开着窗的教室。
collocations: sea level｜海平面 ; at a high level｜在高水平
tip_zh: level 作形容词是“平坦的”。

definition_en: the United States, or the American continents
example1_en: She hopes to visit America after university.
example1_zh: 她希望大学毕业后去美国看看。
example2_en: News from America reaches a classroom in minutes, but students still need to ask who wrote it.
example2_zh: 来自美国的新闻几分钟就能进课堂，但学生仍要问是谁写的。
collocations: North America｜北美洲
tip_zh: 国家名 America 前通常不加 the；the United States 要加 the。

definition_en: a smaller road off a main one
example1_en: We took a side road to avoid the traffic.
example1_zh: 我们走了一条支路以避开车流。
example2_en: A side road without a pavement still forces children into the same space as cars.
example2_zh: 没有人行道的支路，仍然把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。
collocations: side road｜支路
tip_zh: side road 是主路旁边的小路，不要和 roadside（路边）混用。

definition_en: in addition, or different
example1_en: Would anyone else like to speak?
example1_zh: 还有别人想发言吗？
example2_en: If the bus is full, students have little else to do but wait in the rain.
example2_zh: 如果公交满了，学生几乎只能在雨里等。
collocations: or else｜否则 ; something else｜别的东西
tip_zh: else 放在疑问词或不定代词后面：what else、someone else。

meanings_zh: n. 顶部；最高位置 | adj. 最高的
definition_en: the highest part or rank | highest in position or degree
example1_en: My name is at the top of the list.
example1_zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。
example2_en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
example2_zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。
collocations: on top of｜在……上面 ; top student｜优等生
tip_zh: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

meanings_zh: n. 面试；采访 | v. 采访；面试
definition_en: a formal meeting of questions | to ask someone questions in a formal meeting
example1_en: She has an interview at the library on Friday.
example1_zh: 她周五在图书馆有一场面试。
example2_en: An interview that only rewards confidence can miss a quiet student who knows the work.
example2_zh: 只奖励自信的面试，可能错过一个懂业务但安静的学生。
collocations: job interview｜求职面试 ; interview sb｜采访某人
tip_zh: interview 可作名词或动词。采访和面试是同一个词。

definition_en: almost the same
example1_en: The two maps are similar, but not the same.
example1_zh: 两张地图相似，但并不相同。
example2_en: Similar test scores can hide very different chances to study at home.
example2_zh: 相似的考分可能掩盖在家学习机会的巨大差别。
